title: 第九章 基因序列与玩家等级
content_zh:
下午完成的工作量，几乎是白天的三倍。
一共有足足五十来根粗细不一的木头，被玩家们用绳子和板车牵着，托到了疗养院的围墙边上。
老实说，这些玩家的表现出乎了楚光的意料。
每根木头长度都在10到8米之间，长的甚至能到20米，而且一多半都是大腿粗细。
楚光统计了一下，一共2000点贡献。
其中老白的成果最多，一个人就干到了800点，狂风大概是最惨的，这家伙的克隆体不擅长运动，也就是普通人的体格，忙了一整天也就赚了300点。
至于这玩意儿有什么用？
楚光还没想好。
避难所现在穷的一批，他兜里就两块棒棒糖，之前还有个压缩饼干，但已经被他啃掉了。
思来想去，他只告诉了玩家们，复活除了需要等待三天之外，还得花费复活币。
而复活币，需要贡献点购买。
虽然贡献点的“购买力”单薄了点，但玩家们似乎也没太在意。
毕竟现在是封测阶段，游戏内容少是可以理解的。只要不删档，多囤点钱，等开服了总能找到消费的地方。
另外，贡献点没有实体，只是一个数字，暂时只能下线之后，在登陆官网查看。
虽然楚光也想学着巨石城，弄些看得见摸得着的硬币出来，但没办法，避难所的条件太艰苦，连“铸币”的材料都凑不出来。
他总不能给玩家们发筹码。
那玩意儿虽然是清泉市这一带的硬通货，但他自己也不剩几个了。
况且直接发筹码给他们也没用，玩家们也不可能自己去幸存者据点交易。
自己和幸存者们能沟通，那是因为自己是魂穿到这边，脑袋里装着这个世界的语言。
而那些玩家们使用的克隆体，完全就是一张白纸，连基本心智都不具备，更不可能存在继承记忆这一说法了。

清泉市这一带幸存者们使用的语言，是人联通用语。
这种语言和现世那边任意国家、民族的语言都完全不同，最多也只是语法和发音上和汉语存在少许相似。
以后楚光会考虑开发一套翻译工具，来解决玩家们和“NPC”沟通的问题，顺便再重新设计一下分配制度和经济系统。
但不是现在。
清点完今天的工作成果，天色也不早了。
楚光抬头看了一眼天边的斜阳，微微眯了下眼。
要到晚上了。
“管理者大人，我发现我们的前哨没有电，”方长走上前来，说道，“为什么我们不想办法弄一台发电机？”
这个问题问得好。
可惜等于废话。
“我们没有额外的发电机，”楚光看向了他，“你们谁懂这方面？或者有电工相关的技术？”
玩家们面面相觑。
“不能从地下牵一根线上来吗？”夜十同学问了个很弱智的问题。
“没有那么长的线路，而且避难所里的能源也不是无限的，就算短期能用，长期的问题仍然无法解决，还会埋下更大的隐患。”
说到这里，楚光停顿了下。
“时间不早了，我们该回去了。”
这里说的回去，对于玩家们而言指的自然是“下线”。
虽然天还没全黑，但现在时间已经是下午五点，平行世界的华国那边马上就要天亮了。
不知不觉已经在游戏世界待了这么久，恍然间回过神来的玩家们，脸上都是意犹未尽的表情。
总感觉这个世界还有很多值得探索的地方。

但白天还有工作要做，不可能一直待在这里。
404号避难所内。
看着回到培养舱中躺下的玩家们，楚光寻思着，或许自己也该试着招募一些白天没有工作的闲人。
或者其他时区的玩家。
要不这一到晚上，偌大的前哨基地就只剩自己一个人，从安全的角度来讲也不太合适。
“今天继续睡避难所里好了。”
没有必要的话，他实在不想回贝特街的那个“狗窝”了。
就在楚光寻思着干点什么的时候，小柒来到了他的身旁。
“主人。”
“怎么了？”
“克隆体的体检报告更新了，请问您要看一下吗？”
楚光略微迟疑了下。
“……体检报告？”
“嗯！每次玩家正常登出之后，培养舱都会对舱内克隆体进行扫描，记录克隆体身体机能状况，并抽取一定数量的胚胎干细胞进行备份，记录基因序列开发进度——”
“等等，基因序列是啥玩意儿？”
听到这个陌生的关键词，楚光总感觉自己漏掉了什么关键信息。
面对管理者的疑问，小柒不以为然回答。
“您没有发现吗？每个玩家使用的克隆体都由不同的DNA合成的，基因序列就是不同DNA的编号。”
楚光紧接着问：“那开发进度又是什么？？”
“每一个序列的DNA都是经过精心设计的，然而遗憾的是，我们并未完全掌握生命的奥秘。”

“并不是所有遗传学信息的性状，都得到了完全表达。这就好像运动员的孩子更容易成为运动员，但并不是一生下来就是运动员。”
“而所谓开发进度，就是指基因序列中特殊片段的显性表达程度，通常用百分比来表示。”
“比如开发进度达到100%，就是生命体的各项性能都已经无限接近于基因设计的极限，达到了最完美的状态……但这几乎是不可能的。”
“目前我们已激活的四个基因序列，开发进度都介于0~1%之间。根据研究表明，只要不断地激发生存本能、锻炼肉体，就能够提高这一数值。”
如果把“基因序列”理解成职业，“开发进度”大概就类似于等级。
侧重力量强化的基因序列，就像是DND规则中的“野蛮人”，先天拥有更强的力量，并且倾向于提升力量属性。
比如“白驹过隙”。
别的玩家都挺正常，就他体毛浓密块头大，明显不像是正常人。
好家伙。
这些克隆体——哦不，玩家们，原来是可以升级的！
而且还有天赋这种设定！
这么牛批的事情，他居然现在才知道！
看着若无其事解释着的小柒，楚光忍不住道。
“这么重要的事情你怎么现在才告诉我？？？”
小柒委屈说道：“您不是让我不要冷不丁的开口吗？我本来一开始就打算告诉您的。”
楚光：“……”
这家伙……
绝逼是故意的！
content_en:
The amount of work completed in the afternoon is almost three times that of the day.
There were a total of about fifty logs of different thicknesses, which were led by the players with ropes and carts and carried to the wall of the sanatorium.
To be honest, the performance of these players exceeded Chu Guang's expectations.
Each piece of wood is between 10 and 8 meters long, and some can even reach 20 meters long, and more than half of them are as thick as a thigh.
Chu Guang counted and found a total of 2,000 points of contribution.
Among them, Lao Bai achieved the most results, reaching 800 points by himself. Guangfeng was probably the worst. This guy's clone was not good at sports and had the physique of an ordinary person. He only earned 300 points after working all day.
As for what is the use of this thing?
Chu Guang hasn't thought about it yet.
The shelter is now one of the poor. He only has two lollipops in his pocket. He also had a compressed biscuit before, but he has already chewed it up.
After thinking about it, he only told the players that in addition to waiting for three days for resurrection, they also had to spend resurrection coins.
Resurrection coins require contribution points to purchase.
Although the "purchasing power" of contribution points is a bit thin, players don't seem to care too much.
After all, it is in the closed beta stage, so it is understandable that there is little content in the game. As long as you don't delete files and save more money, you can always find a place to spend when the server opens.
In addition, the contribution point has no entity, it is just a number. It can only be viewed after logging in to the official website after going offline for the time being.
Although Chu Guang also wanted to imitate Boulder City and get some tangible coins, he had no choice. The conditions in the shelter were too difficult and he couldn't even get the materials to "mint coins".
He can't always hand out chips to players.
Although that stuff is hard currency in Qingquan City, he doesn't have a few left.
Moreover, it is useless to send chips to them directly, and it is impossible for players to go to the survivor stronghold to trade by themselves.
The reason why I can communicate with the survivors is because my soul traveled here and I have the language of this world in my head.
The clones used by the players are completely blank sheets of paper. They do not even have basic mental abilities, and there is no possibility of inheriting memories.
The language used by the survivors in this area of ​​Qingquan City is the People's United Language.
This language is completely different from the language of any country or nation in the world. At most, it is only slightly similar to Chinese in terms of grammar and pronunciation.
In the future, Chu Guang will consider developing a translation tool to solve the problem of communication between players and "NPCs", and also redesign the distribution system and economic system.
But not now.
After counting today's work results, it's getting dark.
Chu Guang raised his head and glanced at the setting sun on the horizon, then narrowed his eyes slightly.
It's evening.
"Master Manager, I found that our outpost has no power," Fang Chang stepped forward and said, "Why don't we find a way to get a generator?"
This is a good question.
It's a pity that it's nonsense.
"We don't have extra generators," Chu Guang looked at him, "Which of you knows this? Or has electrician-related skills?"
The players looked at each other.
"Can't you pull a thread up from the ground?" Ye Shi asked a very stupid question.
"There are not such long lines, and the energy in the shelter is not unlimited. Even if it can be used in the short term, the long-term problem still cannot be solved, and greater hidden dangers will be laid."
Speaking of this, Chu Guang paused.
"It's getting late, we should go back."
When I talk about it here, for players, it naturally refers to "offline".
Although it is not completely dark yet, it is already five o'clock in the afternoon, and it will soon be dawn in the Chinese country of the parallel world.
Unknowingly, they have been in the game world for so long, and the players who suddenly came back to their senses had expressions of unfinished content on their faces.
I always feel that there are still many places worth exploring in this world.
But there is work to do during the day, it is impossible to stay here forever.
Inside Vault 404.
Looking at the players who returned to lie down in the training cabin, Chu Guang thought, maybe he should also try to recruit some idle people who had no work during the day.
Or players in other time zones.
Otherwise, at night, I would be the only one left in the huge outpost, which would not be suitable from a security perspective.
"Just continue to sleep in the shelter today."
He really didn't want to go back to the "doghouse" on Beit Street if he didn't have to.
Just when Chu Guang was thinking about what to do, Xiao Qi came to him.
"Master."
"What's wrong?"
"The clone's physical examination report has been updated. Would you like to take a look?"
Chu Guang hesitated slightly.
"...Medical examination report?"
"Yeah! Every time the player logs out normally, the culture cabin will scan the clones in the cabin, record the clone's physical condition, extract a certain number of embryonic stem cells for backup, and record the progress of gene sequence development -"
"Wait, what is a genetic sequence?"
Hearing this unfamiliar keyword, Chu Guang always felt that he had missed some key information.
Faced with the manager's question, Xiaoqi answered disapprovingly.
"Didn't you notice? The clones used by each player are synthesized from different DNA, and the gene sequence is the number of the different DNA."
Chu Guang then asked: "Then what is the development progress??"
"Every sequence of DNA is carefully designed, but unfortunately, we do not fully grasp the mysteries of life."
"Not all traits with genetic information have been fully expressed. It's like the children of athletes are more likely to become athletes, but they are not born athletes."
"The so-called development progress refers to the degree of dominant expression of special fragments in the gene sequence, which is usually expressed as a percentage."
"For example, if the development progress reaches 100%, it means that the various properties of the living body are infinitely close to the limits of genetic design and have reached the most perfect state... But this is almost impossible."
"Currently, the development progress of the four gene sequences we have activated is between 0 and 1%. According to research, this value can be improved as long as the survival instinct is continuously stimulated and the body is exercised."
If "gene sequence" is understood as a profession, "development progress" is probably similar to level.
Gene sequences that focus on strength enhancement are like "barbarians" in the DND rules. They are born with stronger strength and tend to improve strength attributes.
For example, "a fleeting moment passes by".
Other players were pretty normal, but he was thick and thick, so he obviously didn't look like a normal person.
Good guy.
These clones - oh no, players, it turns out they can be upgraded!
And there is also the setting of talent!
He actually only knows about such an incredible thing now!
Looking at Xiao Qi who was explaining as if nothing had happened, Chu Guang couldn't help but say.
"Why are you telling me such an important thing now???"
Xiao Qi said aggrievedly: "Didn't you ask me not to speak so abruptly? I originally planned to tell you from the beginning."
Chu Guang: "..."
This guy...
It’s absolutely on purpose!
